## User Parameters

Edit this chunk to change the benchmark grid. Re-knit to re-run.
The fitting cache is automatically invalidated when any parameter here changes.

```{r params, echo=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# USER PARAMETERS
# ============================================================
p_star_grid        <- c(1, 3, 10)    # numbers of causal SNPs to simulate
annotation_r2_grid <- c(0.2, 0.8)   # annotation quality: r2(a[causal], beta[causal])
noise_grid         <- c(0.5, 0.8)   # noise fraction: proportion of total variance = noise
n_seeds            <- 3              # seeds per grid cell (increase for replication)
L                  <- 10              # number of single effects
max_iter           <- 50             # max IBSS iterations per fit
inflate_match      <- 1              # non-causal annotation noise (0 = zeros, 1 = matched variance)

# Degeneracy thresholds (Section D)
c_degen_low    <- 0.1    # c < this (and c < 0) is degenerate (signal suppressed/flipped)
c_degen_high   <- 10.0   # c > this is degenerate (signal exploded)
sig_degen_low  <- 0.01   # sigma_0_2 < this is degenerate (collapsed)
sig_degen_high <- 1.0    # sigma_0_2 > this is degenerate (inflated)

methods <- c(
  "none", "none_annotated", "var", "scale_var", "scale"
)
# ============================================================
```

```{r derived-params, echo=FALSE}
total_runs <- length(c("N3", "KLK11", "AMT")) *
              length(p_star_grid) * length(annotation_r2_grid) *
              length(noise_grid) * n_seeds
cat(sprintf("Grid: 3 X sources x %d p* x %d r2 x %d noise x %d seeds = **%d runs/method** (%d total fits)\n",
            length(p_star_grid), length(annotation_r2_grid),
            length(noise_grid), n_seeds,
            total_runs, total_runs * length(methods)))
```

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

local({

  if (!is.null(rmd_path) && nzchar(rmd_path)) setwd(dirname(rmd_path))
})

suppressPackageStartupMessages(devtools::load_all("../../", quiet = TRUE))

# --- SuSiE N3 (standard benchmark, ~574 x 1001) ---

# --- Real M1-stratified genotype matrices (scenario_1, n=600, ~1000 SNPs) ---

load_tsv_gz <- function(path) {

  mat <- readr::read_tsv(path,
    col_types      = readr::cols(.default = "d", participant_ID = "c"),

  storage.mode(m) <- "double"
  m
}
```

## Simulation Helpers

```{r helpers}
# Annotation vector matching test_susine::simulate_priors() behaviour.
# Causal SNPs: a = beta + noise  (targeting annotation_r2 on causal indices).
# Non-causal SNPs: white noise with variance matched to causal annotation variance
# (controlled by inflate_match; 0 = zeros, 1 = matched variance).
make_annotation <- function(beta, annotation_r2, inflate_match = 1, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  causal <- which(beta != 0)
  p <- length(beta)
  a <- rep(0, p)
  if (length(causal) == 0 || annotation_r2 <= 0) return(a)

  b_c  <- beta[causal]
  b_sd <- if (length(b_c) > 1) sd(b_c) else abs(b_c)
  if (b_sd == 0) b_sd <- 1

  # Causal: annotation = true beta + noise (targeting annotation_r2)
  noise_sd <- b_sd * sqrt((1 - annotation_r2) / annotation_r2)
  a[causal] <- b_c + rnorm(length(b_c), 0, noise_sd)

  # Non-causal: white noise with variance matched to causal annotation variance
  if (inflate_match > 0) {
    causal_var <- var(a[causal])
    if (is.na(causal_var) || causal_var == 0) causal_var <- noise_sd^2
    noncausal_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(p), causal)
    a[noncausal_idx] <- rnorm(length(noncausal_idx), 0, sqrt(inflate_match * causal_var))
  }
  a
}

# Phenotype: noise_fraction = proportion of total variance that is noise.
make_phenotype <- function(X, beta, noise_fraction, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  Xb         <- drop(X %*% beta)
  signal_var <- mean(Xb^2)
  sigma2 <- if (signal_var == 0 || noise_fraction >= 1) 1
            else signal_var * noise_fraction / (1 - noise_fraction)
  y <- Xb + rnorm(nrow(X), 0, sqrt(sigma2))
  y - mean(y)
}

# AUPRC via trapezoidal integration
compute_auprc <- function(pips, is_causal) {
  ord          <- order(pips, decreasing = TRUE)
  truth_sorted <- is_causal[ord]
  tp           <- cumsum(truth_sorted)
  fp           <- cumsum(!truth_sorted)
  precision    <- tp / (tp + fp)
  recall       <- tp / max(sum(is_causal), 1L)
  n_pts        <- length(recall)
  if (n_pts < 2) return(NA_real_)
  sum(diff(recall) * (precision[-1] + precision[-n_pts]) / 2)
}
```

## Fitting Loop

This chunk is cached. Re-knit with unchanged parameters reuses the cache.
Change any parameter above to invalidate the cache and re-run.

```{r fitting-loop, cache=TRUE, cache.extra=list(p_star_grid, annotation_r2_grid, noise_grid, n_seeds, L, methods, max_iter, inflate_match), message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
run_results <- data.frame(
  run_id = integer(), x_source = character(), p_star = integer(),
  annotation_r2 = numeric(), noise = numeric(), seed = integer(),
  method = character(), auprc = numeric(), final_elbo = numeric(),
  n_iter = integer(), error = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

effect_results <- data.frame(
  run_id = integer(), x_source = character(), p_star = integer(),
  annotation_r2 = numeric(), noise = numeric(), seed = integer(),
  method = character(), effect = integer(),
  c_l = numeric(), sigma_0_2_l = numeric(), mu_eff_l = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

run_id <- 0
fit_count <- 0
total_fits <- total_runs * length(methods)
cat(sprintf("Running %d total fits ...\n", total_fits))

for (x_name in names(x_list)) {
  X_full <- x_list[[x_name]]
  p_full <- ncol(X_full)
  for (p_star in p_star_grid) {
    for (r2 in annotation_r2_grid) {
      for (noise_frac in noise_grid) {
        for (s in seq_len(n_seeds)) {
          run_id    <- run_id + 1
          base_seed <- run_id * 17 + s

          set.seed(base_seed)
          causal       <- sample(p_full, min(p_star, p_full))
          beta         <- rep(0, p_full)
          beta[causal] <- rnorm(p_star, 0, 0.8)
          is_causal    <- (beta != 0)
          y <- make_phenotype(X_full, beta, noise_frac, seed = base_seed + 1)
          a <- make_annotation(beta, r2, inflate_match = inflate_match,
                               seed = base_seed + 2)

          for (m in methods) {
            # Dispatch: determine mu_0 and actual prior_update_method
            if (m == "none") {
              mu_0_input <- NULL
              fit_method <- "none"
            } else if (m == "none_annotated") {
              mu_0_input <- a
              fit_method <- "none"
            } else if (m == "var") {
              mu_0_input <- NULL
              fit_method <- m
            } else {
              mu_0_input <- a
              fit_method <- m
            }

            fit_count <- fit_count + 1
            if (fit_count %% 20 == 0 || fit_count == 1 || fit_count == total_fits) {
              cat(sprintf("  Fit %d / %d (%.0f%%) — %s / %s / p*=%d / r2=%.1f / noise=%.1f / seed=%d\n",
                          fit_count, total_fits, 100 * fit_count / total_fits,
                          m, x_name, p_star, r2, noise_frac, s))
            }

            # Suppress susine's convergence prints while preserving errors
            fit <- tryCatch({
              invisible(capture.output(
                .res <- susine(L = L, X = X_full, y = y,
                               mu_0 = mu_0_input, sigma_0_2 = 0.2,
                               prior_update_method = fit_method,
                               max_iter = max_iter, tol = 1e-4),
                type = "output"))
              .res
            }, error = function(e) list(error = conditionMessage(e)))

            if (!is.null(fit$error)) {
              run_results <- rbind(run_results, data.frame(
                run_id = run_id, x_source = x_name, p_star = p_star,
                annotation_r2 = r2, noise = noise_frac, seed = s, method = m,
                auprc = NA, final_elbo = NA, n_iter = NA,
                error = fit$error, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
            } else {
              run_results <- rbind(run_results, data.frame(
                run_id = run_id, x_source = x_name, p_star = p_star,
                annotation_r2 = r2, noise = noise_frac, seed = s, method = m,
                auprc      = compute_auprc(fit$model_fit$PIPs, is_causal),
                final_elbo = tail(fit$model_fit$elbo, 1),
                n_iter     = length(fit$model_fit$elbo) - 1L,
                error = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))

              alpha_mat <- fit$effect_fits$alpha
              b_hat_mat <- fit$effect_fits$b_hat
              sigma_mat <- fit$priors$sigma_0_2
              c_vec     <- fit$priors$mu_0_scale_factor

              for (l in seq_len(L)) {
                effect_results <- rbind(effect_results, data.frame(
                  run_id = run_id, x_source = x_name, p_star = p_star,
                  annotation_r2 = r2, noise = noise_frac, seed = s,
                  method = m, effect = l,
                  c_l         = if (!is.null(c_vec) && length(c_vec) >= l) c_vec[l] else 1,
                  sigma_0_2_l = sigma_mat[l, 1],
                  mu_eff_l    = sum(b_hat_mat[l, ]),
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
cat(sprintf("\nDone. %d fits completed, %d errors.\n", sum(run_results$error == ""), sum(run_results$error != "")))

# Derived columns used throughout
ok  <- run_results %>% dplyr::filter(error == "")
err <- run_results %>% dplyr::filter(error != "")

# Method ordering by overall mean AUPRC (descending) — used in all plots
method_order <- ok %>%
  dplyr::group_by(method) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_auprc = mean(auprc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(mean_auprc) %>%
  dplyr::pull(method)

ok <- ok %>%
  dplyr::mutate(method = factor(method, levels = method_order))
effect_results <- effect_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(method = factor(method, levels = method_order))
```

## Section B: AUPRC by Scenario

```{r sec-b-helpers, echo=FALSE}
heatmap_auprc <- function(data, x_col, x_lab) {
  hm <- data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(method, .data[[x_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_auprc = mean(auprc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(x_val = factor(.data[[x_col]]))

  ggplot(hm, aes(x = x_val, y = method, fill = mean_auprc)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", mean_auprc)), size = 3.2) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", limits = c(0, NA), name = "Mean\nAUPRC") +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = NULL,
         title = paste("Mean AUPRC by method x", x_lab)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
          panel.grid = element_blank())
}

axis_table <- function(data, x_col) {
  data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(method, .data[[x_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_auprc = round(mean(auprc, na.rm = TRUE), 3), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = dplyr::all_of(x_col), values_from = mean_auprc) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(dplyr::pick(dplyr::last_col())))
}
```

## Section D: Degeneracy Frequencies

Degeneracy thresholds (from parameters above):

- **c negative**: c < 0 (annotation direction flipped — degenerate)
- **c too small**: 0 ≤ c < `r c_degen_low` (signal suppressed)
- **c too large**: c > `r c_degen_high` (signal exploded)
- **σ₀² degenerate**: σ₀² < `r sig_degen_low` or σ₀² > `r sig_degen_high`

```{r sec-d-compute, echo=FALSE}
effect_results <- effect_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    c_neg     = c_l < 0,
    c_small   = c_l >= 0 & c_l < c_degen_low,
    c_large   = c_l > c_degen_high,
    c_degen   = c_neg | c_small | c_large,
    sig_degen = sigma_0_2_l < sig_degen_low | sigma_0_2_l > sig_degen_high,
    any_degen = c_degen | sig_degen
  )
```

### Degeneracy Table

```{r sec-d-table}
degen_tbl <- effect_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(method) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_effects       = dplyr::n(),
    pct_c_neg       = round(100 * mean(c_neg,     na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    pct_c_small     = round(100 * mean(c_small,   na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    pct_c_large     = round(100 * mean(c_large,   na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    pct_c_degen     = round(100 * mean(c_degen,   na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    pct_sig_degen   = round(100 * mean(sig_degen, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    pct_either      = round(100 * mean(any_degen, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups         = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(pct_either))

knitr::kable(degen_tbl,
             col.names = c("Method", "N effects", "% c<0", "% c too small",
                           "% c too large", "% c any degen",
                           "% σ₀² degen", "% either degen"),
             caption = paste0("Degeneracy frequencies  |  ",
                              "c thresholds: negative / [0,", c_degen_low, ") / (",
                              c_degen_high, ",∞)  |  ",
                              "σ₀² thresholds: [", sig_degen_low, ", ", sig_degen_high, "]"))
```

### Degeneracy Frequency Plot

```{r sec-d-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
degen_long <- degen_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(method, pct_c_neg, pct_c_small, pct_c_large, pct_sig_degen) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(pct_c_neg, pct_c_small, pct_c_large, pct_sig_degen),
    names_to  = "degen_type",
    values_to = "pct"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    degen_type = dplyr::recode(degen_type,
      pct_c_neg     = "c < 0 (sign flip)",
      pct_c_small   = paste0("0 ≤ c < ", c_degen_low, " (suppressed)"),
      pct_c_large   = paste0("c > ", c_degen_high, " (exploded)"),
      pct_sig_degen = paste0("σ₀² outside [", sig_degen_low, ", ", sig_degen_high, "]")
    ),
    degen_type = factor(degen_type, levels = c(
      "c < 0 (sign flip)",
      paste0("0 ≤ c < ", c_degen_low, " (suppressed)"),
      paste0("c > ", c_degen_high, " (exploded)"),
      paste0("σ₀² outside [", sig_degen_low, ", ", sig_degen_high, "]")
    )),
    method = factor(method, levels = method_order)
  )

ggplot(degen_long, aes(x = method, y = pct, fill = degen_type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.85) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("steelblue", "gold3", "firebrick", "darkorange"),
                    name = "Degeneracy type") +
  labs(title = "Fraction of effects with degenerate c or σ₀²",
       x = NULL, y = "% of effects") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## Section E: Errors

```{r sec-e}
if (nrow(err) == 0) {
  cat("No errors in any of the", total_runs * length(methods), "fits.\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("%d error(s):\n", nrow(err)))
  knitr::kable(err %>% dplyr::select(run_id, x_source, p_star, annotation_r2, noise, method, error),
               caption = "Errored fits")
}
```
